lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaAlCl₃ crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing five atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers in octahedral coordination by six Cl neighbors, while Cl centers have two Al neighbors and Na centers show a close-packed-like arrangement of twelve Cl neighbors. The Al octahedra share corners with one another and share faces with the 12-vertex Na polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
